Contract Types (In FSU's system - labeled as 'Commodities') - Cannot DELETE - Used to Organize Templates (template must be associated with a Contract Type) - Used to Organize the Custom Fields that will appear on the header. - Can limit contract type by user

Roles/Permissions - Contract Administrator - can create/edit any and all contracts that they have access to - Contract Manager - Can manage their own contracts and see others based on Project Access/other visibility settings - Contract Approver - can approve contracts in workflow approval - Contract Stakeholder - can view full/summary versions of contracts and will receive notifications if they are turned on. Can be set up as Contract Requesters - TCM Admin - CONFIGURATION typically has the Super User permission - Can run import/export, can create contract types, see ALL contracts - even if confidential, can force check-in of any contract - this permission expands the Administrator role

rows: TCM Admin - user with permission to configure TCM, create new custom fields, add new contract types, import legacy contracts, etc.
Contract Administrator - user with permission to create contracts within a specific or multiple Projects/Workgroups AND can edit any contract within those Projects/Workgroups
Contract Manager - user with permission to create contracts within a specific or multiple Projects/Workgroups BUT can only edit their own contracts.
Contract Approver - user with permission to view/approve a contract within contract approval workflow
Contract Stakeholder - user with permission to view full/summary versions of contracts and will receive notifications if they are turned on. Can have permission to 'request contracts'
This permission is necessary to make the ADW permission effective.
Only TCM Admin can add/edit contract parties, but generally FSU's vendor management group will do this.
